scenes.location: Backyard of a cozy suburban home
scenes.description: A small gathering of friends and colleagues is taking place to celebrate the last night of a group member before they move abroad. Music plays softly in the background, and laughter occasionally breaks through the warm summer air. Robin, sitting alone on a bench in the corner, appears distant and overwhelmed by the emotional weight of the event. Nearby, Sara and Spikey are seated on a wicker sofa, exchanging quiet conversation and glancing occasionally at Robin.

characters.name: Robin Young
characters.description: A 26-year-old introverted young professional, Robin is emotionally sensitive and struggling to connect with the lively atmosphere of the farewell party. He is wearing a dark hoodie, which he clutches tightly as a source of comfort.; 26-year-old / Gender Unknown / Party Participant, 24 years old; Occupation: Young Professional; Personality: Emotional, Sensitive, Introverted; Values: Emotional Sincerity, Personal Space; Interests: Music, Technology, Solitude; Experiences: Attending Farewell Party, Handling Emotional Pressure, Feeling Isolated in Social Settings

characters.name: Sara Lin
characters.description: A 28-year-old marketing manager, Sara is warm and empathetic; Female; Age: 28; Occupation: Senior Marketing Strategist; Personality: Observant, supportive, tactful; Values: Loyalty, emotional honesty, community; Interests: Hosting small gatherings, reading self-help and psychology books, yoga; Experiences: Mediated conflicts in workplace teams, helped close friends through major life transitions, organized a surprise farewell event for a colleague moving overseas.

characters.name: Spikey Raja
characters.description: A 27-year-old software developer, Spikey is more reserved but enjoys the company of close friends; Male; Age: 27; Occupation: Software Developer; Personality: Analytical, empathetic, observant; Values: Loyalty, sincerity, personal growth; Interests: Coding challenges, indie music, strategy board games; Experiences: Worked remotely during the pandemic, moved to a new city for a job and made close friends, organized a surprise birthday event for a colleague.

actions.dialogue: Robin quietly stands up from the bench and walks toward the gate, feeling the weight of the evening pressing on his chest.

actions.action: Notices Robin's departure and calls out to him
actions.dialogue: Sara turns to Spikey and says, 'Hey, wait a second. Robin's leaving. Should we stop them?'
Spikey nods, 'Yeah, something's off. Let's go check on them.'

actions.action: Approaches Robin and speaks to them
actions.dialogue: Sara walks up to Robin and says, 'Hey, are you okay? You look like you're about to leave.'
Robin looks at the ground and replies, 'I just... need some space. This is harder than I thought it would be.'

actions.action: Adds a comment to the conversation
actions.dialogue: Spikey says, 'We get it, Robin. It's a big change. But we’re here for you.'
Robin hesitates, looking back at the group, then says, 'I don't know if I can stay. I just feel so out of place here.'

scenes.plot: Robin, overwhelmed by the emotional atmosphere of the farewell party, tries to leave early. Sara and Spikey notice his discomfort and approach him to offer support. Robin's emotional sensitivity and need for personal space are revealed as he struggles with the decision to stay or go.
scenes.social_purpose: To explore the protagonist's internal conflict and emotional needs in a social setting, while highlighting the supportive nature of the group and their shared goal of ensuring Robin feels included.

chunk.text: Robin stands at the edge of the party, feeling the weight of the impending separation. Sara and Spikey approach him, trying to understand his struggle and offer comfort. Robin's emotional fluctuations are evident as he wrestles with his need for solitude and the pressure to connect with the group.
